title: Open-Legal-Products/mike
why_good: The platform addresses a significant gap in accessible legal resources for small businesses and startups, which often struggle to afford legal services.
value: Businesses could subscribe for premium features or pay per document generated, while law firms might pay for access to a streamlined client onboarding tool.
risk: Established legal tech companies could easily integrate similar features, overshadowing a standalone offering.
pick_reason: The platform provides a clear product that can be monetized by offering affordable legal resources for small businesses.
